sources.employees: all regular full-time and part-time employees (primary title only)

fields: salbase (annual base salary incl. stipends >= 1 year)

sources.terms: Disclaimer: made available as a public service; reliance at user's own risk
sources.notes: Verified header and sample rows. Excludes overtime, overload teaching, short-term stipends; base salary only (not actual earnings). Dept ID is a code (e.g. PLAW). Older snapshots are PDFs (rate B) useful for history; only the current file is linked on the page, so archive URLs need collection over time or from search engines.
